address: Matching Rd, Hatfield Heath, Bishop's Stortford,CM22 7AS
bio: Spoil yourself to a luxurious Afternoon Tea experience at Down Hall Hotel, an ornate country house located in Bishop's Stortford.  Afternoon Tea can be served in either the Main Lounge or Terrace, which provides guests with warm and welcoming surroundings to indulge in the great British tradition  Their Afternoon Tea menu features a range of delightful sweet and savoury items including coronation chicken sandwiches, buttermilk scones and strawberry cupcakes. Guests feeling in a decadent mood can upgrade to include a glass of prosecco or Champagne.  Down Hall Hotel is set on the border of Hertfordshire and Essex, just 45 minutes away from Central London.  Please note that Afternoon Tea is priced from £40pp on weekdays and £42.50pp on weekends.
